item.title: Keystone Grid Radio — Tuesday, November 17, 2026
item.description: Morning. So P.J.M. filed its big data-center plan last night. And the headline is speed. It wants to cut the study time to hook up power plants and big loads from two years to one. Half the time. But there's a catch for the data centers, and we'll get to it. Plus a sunny week for field crews, a transformer fire on the Shore, and Chapter Two of Combat Chronicles to close it out.

item.title: Keystone Grid Radio — Monday, November 16, 2026
item.description: Morning. So, P.J.M. is back at the drawing board today. It said it would refile its data-center rules on or about today, after Ferc sent most of the first version back. And it's doing that while its own market monitor says the December auction could add another five to ten billion dollars to bills. Big Monday. We'll get into that, plus a data-center zoning vote right here in Cecil County tonight, and a brand-new chapter of Combat Chronicles to close the show.
